events.name: New Orleans Saints at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 192 yards and a touchdown and the Carolina Panthers held off New Orleans' fourth- quarter rally to beat the Saints 23-20 on Thursday night in a game marred by injuries to key
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers beat Saints 23-20 in game marred by injuries

headlines.description: LeSean McCoy ran 7 yards for a touchdown before suffering a thumb injury, and the Buffalo Bills got just enough out of their depleted offense, beating the Cincinnati Bengals 16-12 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Depleted Bills hold on for 16-12 win over Bengals

headlines.description: Le'Veon Bell scored on a 1-yard TD run -- long after time expired in the first half -- and the Pittsburgh Steelers  snapped a four-game losing streak with a 24-9 win over the Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bell runs for 146 yards, Steelers punish Browns 24-9

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw three touchdown passes, two to Dez Bryant, in the first game with Tony Romo as his backup, as the Dallas Cowboys set a franchise season record with their ninth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott, Cowboys beat Ravens 27-17 for 9th straight win

headlines.description: Eric Ebron had a go-ahead, 1-yard touchdown run early in the fourth quarter and the Detroit Lions went on to beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 26-19 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions beat Jaguars 26-19, winning for 5th time in 6 games

headlines.description: Andrew Luck led the Indianapolis Colts to a big early lead Sunday, and the defense held on in the second half for a 24-17 victory over Tennessee.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts get fast start and hold off charging Titans 24-17

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Jameis Winston sliced up a Kansas City defense missing cornerback Marcus Peters, and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers held on for a 19-17 victory Sunday that snapped the Chiefs' five-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buccaneers snap Chiefs' 5-game win streak with 19-17 victory

headlines.description: Xavier Rhodes returned one of his two interceptions 100 yards for a touchdown and Cordarrelle Patterson took the second-half kickoff 104 yards for a score in Minnesota's 30-24 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Streak stopper: Return TDs spark Vikings, 30-24 over Cards

events.name: Chicago Bears at New York Giants

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw a go-ahead 15-yard touchdown pass to Sterling Shepard in the third quarter as the New York Giants rallied for their fifth straight win, 22-16 over the Bears Sunday at Chicago.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning throws 2 TDs, Giants win fifth straight

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: DeVante Parker caught a 9-yard touchdown pass from Ryan Tannehill with 36 seconds to play, and the Miami Dolphins rallied for two late scores to spoil Jared Goff's NFL debut with a 14-10 victory
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins spoil Goff's debut with rally to beat Rams, 14-10

events.name: New England Patriots at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 280 yards and four touchdowns and the New England Patriots beat San Francisco 30-17 on Sunday in Brady's first road game against the 49ers team he rooted for as a boy.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws 4 TD passes in triumphant Bay Area return

headlines.description: Everyone knew Russell Wilson could run and pass.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws, catches, leads Seahawks past Eagles 26-15

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins went deep late and often, throwing for 375 yards and three touchdowns to lead the Washington Redskins to a 42-24 victory over the free-falling Green Bay Packers on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Redskins light up Packers in high-flying 42-24 rout

headlines.description: Derek Carr woke up a struggling Oakland offense by throwing two touchdown passes in the fourth quarter as the Raiders capped a successful trip to Mexico with a 27-20 victory over the Texans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr helps Raiders rally past Texans 27-20 in Mexico City
